newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA DROPS BELOW 305, IMPLIED RATES EASE.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA DROPS BELOW 305, IMPLIED RATES EASE.

text.p: Ecu/drachma broke the 305 level on the downside to hover around 304.70/90 in late dealings on the back of ecu sales for drachmas and implied drachma rates from forex forwards made a U-turn to land lower, dealers said.
"Sales of ecus for drachmas from abroad have sent ecu/drachma below 305," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
Money market dealers said depos were unchanged with the central bank holding its overnight bid unchanged at 12.40 percent.

Implied rates from forex forwards were trading below 15 basis points lower early levels after spending most of their time today in a 25 basis point corridor formed around morning levels, dealers said.
Sales of recently auctioned T-bills by banks were estimated around 80 billion drachmas.
Secondary bond activity in other securities was thin in the absence of fresh factors.

A total of 300 billion drachmas in competitive bids and 90 billion in non-competitive bids were allocated at the auction of 12-month T-bills on Monday. The average bid stood at 90.15 and hte cutoff price at 90.04.
The mark was quoted at 157.15/25 drachmas from Wednesday's 157.370 fix, the dollar at 258.81/91 drachmas from 259.310 and the Ecu at 304.86/96 from 305.000 drachmas.
